paracetamol.mechanism: Centrally acting inhibitor of prostaglandin synthesis with minimal peripheral anti-inflammatory activity.
indications: Mild to moderate pain (headache, toothache, musculoskeletal pain, osteoarthritis)
Fever reduction in adults and children
paracetamol.standard_dosage: Adults: 500mg to 1000mg every 4 to 6 hours as needed. Maximum daily dose: 4000mg (4g) for healthy adults; 2000-3000mg recommended for long-term use or elderly.
severe_side_effects: Hepatotoxicity (severe acute liver failure in overdose or chronic alcohol intake)
Rare serious skin reactions (Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis)
warnings: Black Box Warning: Acute liver failure risks associated with doses exceeding 4000mg in 24 hours.
Check all combination cold/flu products to avoid accidental acetaminophen overdose.
Use caution in chronic alcohol users (>3 drinks/day) or patients with pre-existing hepatic disease.
paracetamol.storage: Store at room temperature (20°C to 25°C / 68°F to 77°F) away from moisture and excessive heat.

ibuprofen.mechanism: Reversibly inhibits cyclooxygenase-1 (COX-1) and cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) enzymes, reducing prostaglandin production.
indications: Mild to moderate pain, dysmenorrhea (menstrual cramps)
ibuprofen.standard_dosage: OTC: 200mg to 400mg every 4 to 6 hours with food. Max OTC daily dose: 1200mg. Prescription max: 3200mg/day under medical supervision.
severe_side_effects: Gastrointestinal ulceration, bleeding, or perforation (can be fatal)
warnings: Black Box Warning: Increased risk of serious cardiovascular thrombotic events and serious gastrointestinal adverse events.
Avoid taking with other NSAIDs (e.g. naproxen, aspirin) without medical advice.
Take with food or milk to minimize stomach irritation.
Avoid during the third trimester of pregnancy due to premature closure of fetal ductus arteriosus.
ibuprofen.storage: Store at room temperature (20°C to 25°C) in a dry place.

lisinopril.mechanism: Inhibits ACE, blocking conversion of Angiotensin I to Angiotensin II, causing vasodilation and decreased aldosterone secretion.
indications: Post-myocardial infarction (within 24 hours to improve survival)
lisinopril.standard_dosage: Hypertension: Initial 10mg once daily; maintenance 20-40mg daily as prescribed by a physician.
severe_side_effects: Angioedema (swelling of lips, tongue, face, or airway - emergency)
warnings: Black Box Warning: Fetal toxicity. Discontinue immediately upon pregnancy detection.
Do not use potassium supplements or salt substitutes without physician approval.
Monitor renal function and serum potassium periodically.
lisinopril.storage: Store between 20°C and 25°C. Protect from moisture and excessive light.

metformin.mechanism: Decreases hepatic glucose production, decreases intestinal absorption of glucose, and improves insulin sensitivity.
metformin.standard_dosage: Initial: 500mg twice daily or 850mg once daily with meals. Max daily dose: 2000-2550mg in divided doses.
severe_side_effects: Lactic acidosis (rare but life-threatening metabolic emergency)
Vitamin B12 deficiency with long-term use
warnings: Black Box Warning: Lactic acidosis risk in renal impairment, sepsis, severe hepatic disease, or excessive alcohol intake.
Must be temporarily withheld prior to iodinated radiocontrast imaging procedures.
Take with meals to reduce gastrointestinal side effects.
metformin.storage: Store at 20°C to 25°C. Keep container tightly closed.

amoxicillin.mechanism: Binds to penicillin-binding proteins, inhibiting bacterial cell wall peptidoglycan synthesis.
indications: Bacterial infections of the respiratory tract (otitis media, sinusitis, pneumonia)
Urinary tract infections and skin infections
amoxicillin.standard_dosage: Adults: 250mg to 500mg every 8 hours, or 500mg to 875mg every 12 hours. Complete full course as prescribed.
severe_side_effects: Severe anaphylaxis / allergic reaction in penicillin-allergic patients
warnings: Contraindicated in individuals with documented severe penicillin allergy.
Finish the entire prescribed course even if symptoms resolve early to prevent antimicrobial resistance.
Ineffective against viral infections (colds, flu).
amoxicillin.storage: Tablets/Capsules: 20°C to 25°C. Reconstituted liquid: Store in refrigerator, discard after 14 days.

atorvastatin.mechanism: Competitively inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, the rate-limiting enzyme in cholesterol biosynthesis, upregulating LDL receptors.
indications: Prevention of cardiovascular events (myocardial infarction, stroke) in high-risk patients
atorvastatin.standard_dosage: 10mg to 80mg once daily, taken at any time of day with or without food.
severe_side_effects: Rhabdomyolysis (severe muscle breakdown with acute renal failure)
warnings: Report unexplained muscle pain, tenderness, or weakness promptly, especially with dark urine.
Avoid excessive intake of grapefruit juice (>1 liter/day), which inhibits CYP3A4 metabolism.
Contraindicated in active liver disease and during pregnancy/breastfeeding.

omeprazole.mechanism: Irreversibly inhibits H+/K+ ATPase pump in gastric parietal cells, suppressing gastric acid secretion.
omeprazole.standard_dosage: 20mg to 40mg once daily taken 30 to 60 minutes before the first meal of the day.
common_side_effects: Abdominal pain, nausea, constipation, or diarrhea
severe_side_effects: Bone fractures (hip, wrist, spine) with long-term high-dose therapy
Hypomagnesemia, vitamin B12 deficiency with prolonged use
warnings: OTC treatment should generally not exceed 14 consecutive days without medical re-evaluation.
Do not crush or chew delayed-release capsules/tablets.
Interacts with Clopidogrel (reduces antiplatelet efficacy).
omeprazole.storage: Store at 15°C to 30°C. Protect from light and moisture.

amlodipine.mechanism: Inhibits transmembrane influx of calcium ions into vascular smooth muscle and cardiac muscle, causing peripheral vasodilation.
indications: Coronary artery disease (chronic stable angina, vasospastic angina)
amlodipine.standard_dosage: Initial: 5mg once daily; maximum dose: 10mg once daily.
common_side_effects: Peripheral edema (swelling of ankles or lower legs)
severe_side_effects: Worsening angina or acute MI upon dose initiation/titration (rare)
warnings: Monitor blood pressure regularly.
Peripheral edema is dose-dependent and does not necessarily indicate heart failure.
Use with caution in patients with severe aortic stenosis or hepatic impairment.
amlodipine.storage: Store at 15°C to 30°C. Protect from light.

aspirin.mechanism: Irreversibly inhibits COX-1, suppressing platelet thromboxane A2 synthesis and platelet aggregation.
indications: Acute coronary syndrome / acute MI management
aspirin.standard_dosage: Cardioprotection: 81mg (low dose) once daily. Pain/fever: 325-650mg every 4-6 hours.
common_side_effects: Easy bruising and prolonged bleeding time
severe_side_effects: Reye's syndrome in children/teens recovering from viral infections
warnings: NEVER give aspirin to children or teenagers with viral illness (risk of fatal Reye's syndrome).
High risk of severe bleeding when combined with other anticoagulants (e.g. Warfarin, Apixaban) or NSAIDs.
Discontinue before elective surgery if instructed by surgeon.
aspirin.storage: Store at 20°C to 25°C in a dry place.

warfarin.mechanism: Inhibits vitamin K epoxide reductase, depleting functional vitamin K-dependent clotting factors (II, VII, IX, X).
indications: Prophylaxis and treatment of venous thrombosis and pulmonary embolism
Prevention of thromboembolic events in atrial fibrillation or prosthetic heart valves
warfarin.standard_dosage: Highly individualized based on regular INR (International Normalized Ratio) blood monitoring. Typically 2mg to 5mg daily.
common_side_effects: Mild bruising, prolonged bleeding from small cuts
severe_side_effects: Major life-threatening hemorrhage (GI bleeding, intracranial hemorrhage)
warnings: Black Box Warning: Major or fatal bleeding risks. Requires frequent INR laboratory testing.
Extreme number of drug-drug, herbal, and dietary interactions (maintain consistent vitamin K/green leafy vegetable intake).
Strictly contraindicated in pregnancy (teratogenic).
warfarin.storage: Store at 20°C to 25°C. Protect from light.

sertraline.mechanism: Potently inhibits presynaptic reuptake of serotonin (5-HT), increasing synaptic serotonin levels.
indications: Panic Disorder, Social Anxiety Disorder, PTSD
sertraline.standard_dosage: Initial: 25mg to 50mg once daily; maximum dose 200mg daily under psychiatric care.
severe_side_effects: Serotonin Syndrome (fever, agitation, tremor, hyperreflexia - emergency)
Suicidal thoughts/behaviors in young adults (<=24 yrs)
Increased bleeding risk when combined with NSAIDs
warnings: Black Box Warning: Increased risk of suicidal thinking in children, adolescents, and young adults during early therapy.
Do not discontinue abruptly (risk of discontinuation syndrome).
Do not combine with MAOIs or other strong serotonergic agents.
